name: Ice Cream Chest Freezer
summary: Low commercial ice-cream chest with independent sliding glass panels and six plain frozen tubs.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / Codex-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python. No external models, scripts, textures, logos or fonts.
accuracy_notes: Static P1 commercial display prop. Two named lid nodes slide along X on separate tracks; gallery supplies no lid controls. Six generic frozen tubs, no readable labels or brands. Partial-open authored pose. Physical devices, WebKit and full mall integration unverified. Not operational refrigeration.
